source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the holy one reading rather than a later shall-be expansion.
key_decisions.before: And I heard the angel of the waters saying, “Just are you, the one who is and who was, O Holy One, for you have brought these judgments.
key_decisions.after: I heard the angel of the waters say: “You are righteous, the one who is and who was, the holy one, because you have judged these things.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And I heard the angel of the waters saying, “Just are you, the one who is and who was, O Holy One, for you have brought these judgments.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the altar itself as speaker rather than supplying another angel.
key_decisions.before: And I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God Almighty, true and just are your judgments.”
key_decisions.after: I heard the altar say, “Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, your judgments are true and righteous.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God Almighty, true and just are your judgments.”

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the abrupt inserted speech and literal clothing image without adding a named speaker.
key_decisions.before: “Look, I am coming like a thief. Blessed is the one who stays awake, keeping his garments on, so that he may not go about naked and be seen exposed!”
key_decisions.after: “Look, I am coming like a thief. Blessed is the one who stays awake and keeps their clothes, so that they do not walk naked and have their shame exposed.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: “Behold, I am coming like a thief. Blessed is the one who stays awake, keeping his garments on, so that he may not go about naked and be seen exposed!”

key_decisions.rationale: Renders the collective gathering by the spirits with the singular Greek form noted; retains the place name without resolving its etymology.
key_decisions.before: And they gathered them at the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon.
key_decisions.after: They gathered them to the place called in Hebrew Harmagedon.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And they gathered them at the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the approximate ancient weight and repeated severity without replacing it with a precise modern measure.
key_decisions.before: And great hailstones, about a talent in weight, fell from heaven on people, and they cursed God for the plague of the hail, because the plague was exceedingly great.
key_decisions.after: Great hailstones, each about a talent in weight, came down from heaven on people. They blasphemed God because of the plague of hail, for that plague was exceedingly great.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And great hailstones, about a talent in weight, fell from heaven on people, and they cursed God for the plague of the hail, because the plague was exceedingly great.
